metadata.description: A B2B list freshness check: who left, who moved, which emails to fix.

plugins.name: b2b-list-freshness-check
plugins.description: Checks how stale a B2B contact list is: an AI Agent re-exports its people from LinkedIn Sales Navigator through Evaboot, verifies the old emails, and reports who left, who changed title and which emails to fix, with one action per person.
